candidate_meaning.shared_service: stateless shared Task transition service with repository revision arbitration
candidate_meaning.per_task_supervisor: one active single-writer supervisor and bounded mailbox per Task with repository epoch fencing

fixed_context.agent_integration: same supervised Rust integration worker and external Reference Agent
fixed_context.repository: same SQLite WAL/FULL schema, transition rules and command dedup
fixed_context.voice: same generated request WAV, macOS Yuna renderer and BlackHole loopback
fixed_context.changed_axis: only Task state transition ownership and command arbitration

normal_cases.T-CREATE: semantic request, Task creation, Agent handoff, result commit and audible result
normal_cases.T-STATUS: Agent progress source event, Task observation commit and audible status
normal_cases.T-CANCEL: semantic control request, cancel commit, Agent confirmation and audible disposition
normal_cases.T-RACE: concurrent cancel and completion for the same Task followed by terminal convergence
normal_cases.T-MULTI: four independent Tasks with a hot-Task race and unaffected progress on the other Tasks
